name: Moldy Tome
summary: Along the Hillsbrad coast, the Moldy Tome lies ruined after a shipwreck. Once part of the Tome of the Cabal, it still draws warlocks seeking its lore on demonic summoning.

sections.title: Lost to the Waves
sections.body: The Tome of the Cabal was a rare work of dark arts held in Lordaeron. Someone vandalized it and tore it in two. One half, now called the Moldy Tome, sailed south toward Menethil Harbor and Ironforge. The ship never arrived. It sank in the dangerous waters west of Southshore, and the half that survived washed ashore south of Azurelode Mine. Damp and surf ruined its pages as murlocs scavenged along the Hillsbrad coast.

sections.title: Reclaiming the Dark Work
sections.body: Though its vellum is mildewed and rotting, the Moldy Tome still holds powerful lore about demons. Warlocks seeking it brave the coastal camps. Krom Stoutarm guides some of them in Ironforge, while Jorah Annison guides others in the Undercity. Joined with its counterpart, the Tattered Manuscript from the caves of Thousand Needles, the restored book gives the precise words needed to summon and bind a felhunter.

faq.answer: The Moldy Tome is half of the rare Tome of the Cabal, a dark book of rituals for summoning demons. Waterlogged and decayed, it is the half lost in a shipwreck.

faq.q: Where did the Moldy Tome end up?
faq.answer: The Moldy Tome washed ashore in Hillsbrad Foothills, west of Southshore and south of Azurelode Mine. Coastal murlocs keep it in their encampment.

faq.q: Why was the tome on a ship?
aliases: why was it lost at sea
faq.answer: A ship carried the Moldy Tome from Lordaeron toward Menethil Harbor, bound for Ironforge scholars. The ship sank off the Hillsbrad coast before completing its voyage.

faq.q: What is needed to complete the Tome of the Cabal?
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal is completed by joining the Moldy Tome with the Tattered Manuscript, its other half. The manuscript ended up at Splithoof Hold in Thousand Needles.

angles.text: As a warlock, you seek the Moldy Tome to help recover the rituals needed to command a felhunter.
